products.name: MSP Tool Stack Design & Standup — PSA, RMM & Patch Management — Commercial
products.short_description: Design, stand up, and integrate the core platform stack your whole managed-services practice runs on — PSA, RMM, and patch management — with PSA↔RMM ticket sync, standardized policies, and a repeatable new-client onboarding workflow. Self-guided, tested.
products.description:
Stand up the platform stack your whole MSP practice runs on

Most managed-services practices grow into a tangle of disconnected tools: the PSA and RMM don't talk, alerts never become tickets, patch compliance is guesswork, and every new client is onboarded differently. This solution designs and stands up the core MSP stack — PSA, RMM, and patch management — as one integrated, standardized platform: alert→ticket flow, asset/CMDB sync, consistent monitoring and patch policies, and a repeatable client-onboarding template. Vendor-agnostic (named examples for common PSA/RMM/patch products); product-specific clicks point to the chosen vendor's console.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the standardized MSP operating model: PSA + RMM + patch, their integrations, and repeatable onboarding.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (PSA + RMM + patch platforms & licensing, admin roles, API keys for PSA↔RMM, naming/site taxonomy, MFA on the tools, a pilot client) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing, plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Implementation Guide — ordered steps: design the standards, stand up each platform, wire the integrations, onboard a pilot client with the named template, validate, and operate.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — stack/integration readiness discovery, validation, coverage/onboarding report, safe remediation, and a new-client onboarding scaffolder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices for a standardized MSP stack.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A standardized, integrated MSP platform stack — PSA, RMM, and patch — with alert-to-ticket flow and a repeatable onboarding template, so every managed client runs the same reliable way.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MSPSTACK-Discovery.ps1 — MSPSTACK-Discovery — Inventory current MSP tooling and integration readiness
    • MSPSTACK-Remediation.ps1 — MSPSTACK-Remediation — Apply safe fixes for common stack drift
    • MSPSTACK-Report.ps1 — MSPSTACK-Report — Export stack-coverage and onboarding status to CSV
    • MSPSTACK-Set-ClientOnboarding.ps1 — MSPSTACK-Set-ClientOnboarding — Scaffold a new managed client's site, policies,
    • MSPSTACK-Validation.ps1 — MSPSTACK-Validation — Verify PSA / RMM / patch and integration health (PASS/FAIL)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
